The feeling we’re creating

Your people. Your kind of evening.

Burgundy & blushEarthy neutralsPlum & candlelight

Sometimes the occasion is simply being together. A private gathering can be a dinner, a surprise, a family reunion or a personal milestone that calls for something special.

Begin with the atmosphere you want: lively and colourful, relaxed and intimate, or elegant after dark. We can discuss a setting that suits both your guests and the venue.

Good to know

Your questions, answered.

Can you style an intimate gathering?+

Yes. Share the venue and guest count so we can discuss a proportionate concept for your space.

Can I bring my own references?+

Yes. Share the colours, photographs or themes that appeal to you. References help us understand the feeling you want to create.

Do you offer fixed prices?+

Every setting is different. Your venue, scale, decoration and coordination requirements inform the personalised quote.

Does an enquiry reserve my date?+

No. Availability and booking arrangements must be confirmed directly with the team before a date is reserved.
